title: Login service returning 503 errors
description: Users are unable to log in to the portal. The authentication service is returning 503 errors intermittently. Approximately 40% of login attempts are failing. Support queue has grown by 300 tickets in the last hour.

title: Batch job failed overnight
description: The nightly ETL batch job failed at 02:34 AM without completing. No error logs were written to the standard location. Data warehouse tables for the finance team are missing today's records.

title: Slow API response times on order service
description: Order submission endpoint averaging 8–12 seconds response time since the 11 PM deployment last night. Normal baseline is under 400ms. No errors in logs but customers are abandoning carts.

title: Database connection pool exhausted
description: The primary PostgreSQL connection pool hit maximum connections at 09:15 AM. Several microservices began throwing connection timeout exceptions. A restart of the connection pooler temporarily resolved the issue.

title: SSL certificate expiry warning
description: Monitoring alert fired for the payments subdomain SSL certificate expiring in 7 days. No action has been taken yet. If expired this will break all payment flows.

title: Deployment rollback needed
description: The v2.3.1 release to production caused checkout failures for users in the EU region. Rollback has been requested by the product team but no engineer has been assigned.

title: Memory leak in reporting service
description: The reporting microservice memory usage grows by ~200MB per hour and requires manual restarts every 6 hours. Issue has been known for 3 weeks but no ticket exists in the backlog.

title: User data export failing
description: Customer requested GDPR data export 5 days ago. The export job fails silently with no user notification. Compliance deadline is 30 days from request; we are already 5 days in.
